defects: Predicate is typed as p : α → Prop with an added [DecidablePred p] instance instead of gold's p : α → Bool; List.find? in Lean 4 core has signature (α → Bool) → List α → Option α, so passing a Prop-valued p relies on an implicit Bool-coercion mechanism that may not directly typecheck, and it introduces a typeclass constraint (DecidablePred p) that has no counterpart in the gold statement

The subsingleton condition 'at most one element of l satisfies p' is expressed via a raw double-∀ implication (∀ x ∈ l, ∀ y ∈ l, p x → p y → x = y) rather than gold's Set.Subsingleton on {x ∈ l₁ | p x}; equivalent in content but tied to the Prop/Bool predicate mismatch above, reducing confidence the two statements are interchangeable as written
